```{=html}
<div class="exploration-section">
  <!-- EXPLORATION HEADER -->
  <div class="exploration-header">
    <div class="hero-eyebrow">Interactive Exploration &bull; Global Geography</div>
    <h1 class="exploration-title">THE GEOGRAPHY OF CHARACTER.</h1>
    <p class="exploration-subtitle">
      Automotive identity was forged across distinct national cultures, engineering philosophies, and regulatory landscapes. Select a country to explore.
    </p>
  </div>

  <!-- MAP STAGE WRAPPER -->
  <div class="map-wrapper">
    <div class="map-topbar">
      <div id="selected-indicator" class="map-selected-readout">
        <span class="map-status-pill"></span>
        <span class="selected-label">Selected:</span>
        <span class="selected-highlight" id="selected-country-name">None</span>
      </div>
      <div class="map-hints">Hover to inspect &bull; Click to select</div>
    </div>

    <div class="map-stage" id="map-container">
      <div id="map-tooltip" class="map-tooltip"></div>
      <svg id="world-map-svg" class="map-svg" viewBox="0 0 960 500" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"></svg>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- D3 & TOPOJSON LIBRARIES -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3"></script>
<script src="data/countries_110m.js"></script>
<script src="data/iso_countries.js"></script>

<script>
// State storage for selected country accessible to next steps
window.selectedCountry = null;

(function initWorldMap() {
  const svg = d3.select("#world-map-svg");
  const container = document.getElementById("map-container");
  const tooltip = document.getElementById("map-tooltip");
  const selectedNameEl = document.getElementById("selected-country-name");

  const width = 960;
  const height = 500;

  // Set explicit SVG viewBox for responsiveness
  svg.attr("viewBox", `0 0 ${width} ${height}`)
     .attr("preserveAspectRatio", "xMidYMid meet");

  const projection = d3.geoEqualEarth();
  const pathGenerator = d3.geoPath().projection(projection);

  // Group layers
  const gBase = svg.append("g").attr("class", "map-base-layer");
  const gCountries = svg.append("g").attr("class", "map-countries-layer");

  function renderTopology(worldData) {
    if (!worldData || !worldData.objects || !worldData.objects.countries) return;

    // Filter out Antarctica (010) for a centered, cinematic presentation of populated landmasses
    const countries = topojson.feature(worldData, worldData.objects.countries).features
      .filter(d => d.id !== "010");

    const isoMap = window.ISO_COUNTRIES || {};

    // Center and scale the world projection cleanly within viewBox
    projection.fitExtent([[30, 20], [width - 30, height - 20]], {
      type: "FeatureCollection",
      features: countries
    });

    // Graticule lines for cartographic drafting aesthetic
    const graticule = d3.geoGraticule10();
    gBase.append("path")
      .datum(graticule)
      .attr("class", "map-graticule")
      .attr("d", pathGenerator);

    let activePath = null;

    gCountries.selectAll("path.world-country")
      .data(countries)
      .enter()
      .append("path")
      .attr("class", "world-country")
      .attr("d", pathGenerator)
      .attr("data-id", d => d.id)
      .on("mouseenter", function(event, d) {
        const iso = isoMap[d.id] || {};
        const countryName = iso.name || d.properties?.name || "Unknown";
        const iso3 = iso.iso3 || "";

        tooltip.innerHTML = `
          <span class="tooltip-name">${countryName}</span>
          ${iso3 ? `<span class="tooltip-iso">${iso3}</span>` : ""}
        `;
        tooltip.style.opacity = "1";
        positionTooltip(event);
      })
      .on("mousemove", function(event) {
        positionTooltip(event);
      })
      .on("mouseleave", function() {
        tooltip.style.opacity = "0";
      })
      .on("click", function(event, d) {
        const iso = isoMap[d.id] || {};
        const countryName = iso.name || d.properties?.name || "Unknown";
        const iso3 = iso.iso3 || "";
        const iso2 = iso.iso2 || "";

        // Deselect previous country
        if (activePath) {
          activePath.classed("is-selected", false);
        }

        // Highlight newly selected country
        activePath = d3.select(this);
        activePath.classed("is-selected", true);

        // Store selected country state
        window.selectedCountry = {
          id: d.id,
          name: countryName,
          iso2: iso2,
          iso3: iso3
        };

        // Update selected display
        if (selectedNameEl) {
          selectedNameEl.innerHTML = `${countryName} ${iso3 ? `<span class="selected-iso">(${iso3})</span>` : ""}`;
        }

        // Emit event for modular integration in future steps
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("countrySelected", { detail: window.selectedCountry }));
      });
  }

  function positionTooltip(event) {
    if (!container) return;
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = event.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = event.clientY - rect.top;
    tooltip.style.left = `${x}px`;
    tooltip.style.top = `${y}px`;
  }

  // Use embedded TopoJSON data or fetch fallback
  if (window.COUNTRIES_110M) {
    renderTopology(window.COUNTRIES_110M);
  } else {
    fetch("data/countries-110m.json")
      .then(res => res.json())
      .then(data => renderTopology(data))
      .catch(err => console.error("Could not load country map data", err));
  }
})();
</script>
```
